what: Time to speed, then a full-brake stop: the nose-lift complaint quantified (pitch sign under brake) plus brake distance.
A 180 at moderate speed: steady-state cornering — slip angle, lateral g and the load the outer wheels carry.
Metronome steering at speed: roll angle per direction change, and how close the body comes to a flip.
Mounting a kerb at a shallow angle: the vertical spike and how far the car is thrown off line.
